# The documentation in the ki.norge.no repo, not the site's /llms.txt

> Index of all documentation in the repo digdir/ki.norge.no, for agents. The site's own /llms.txt describes the content on ki.norge.no and is produced by apps/frontend/src/lib/llms-txt.ts. That is a different file.

- Read CLAUDE.md first. It has the rules and the guards.
- The paths are relative to docs/.
- apps/cms-umbraco/uSync/ is prod's schema. Read the README there before you touch anything in the folder.
- Under Optional is what does not describe the current setup. Historical documents have been deleted and are in git.

## Start

- [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md): the rules for agents, with the schema flow, the uSync guard, deploy, style and what goes in docs.
- [Entry for humans](README.md): a short page with the documents someone in operations needs.
- [Development](development.md): code map, key files in frontend and CMS, addresses and links.
- [Root README](../README.md): points on to docs and CONTRIBUTING.
- [CONTRIBUTING](../CONTRIBUTING.md): running locally, workflow, style and browser support.

## Operations

- [System documentation](system-documentation.md): Cloudflare, dis-core, uSync, database, media, search, health check and the environments.
- [Deploy](deploy.md): the recipe for frontend, CMS (also `scripts/deploy-cms.sh`) and the two workers, and the order when several parts change.
- [Content mirroring to tt02](content-mirroring-tt02.md): manual copying of content from prod to tt02 with uSync and `scripts/sync-prod-til-tt02.sh`. The images do not come along.
- [Dependencies](dependencies.md): where the dependencies live, how they are updated and the traps from earlier rounds.
- [Composers in the CMS](cms-composers.md): what each composer does, whether it runs in prod and tt02, which config turns it on, and the traps.
- [Cache purge](cloudflare-cache-purge.md): how the CMS purges the Cloudflare cache on publish, and the purge on deploy.
- [syncroot](syncroot.md): the Kubernetes manifests for the CMS in dis-core.
- [syncroot/README.md](../syncroot/README.md): points to syncroot.md and deploy.md.
- [Password rules for CMS users](cms-password-rules.md): the requirements for local passwords. Normal login goes through Entra ID.

## CMS and schema

- [uSync/README.md](../apps/cms-umbraco/uSync/README.md): STOP. The folder is prod's schema, and regenerating or exporting from another environment makes block content "Unsupported".
- [uSync-testinnhold/README.md](../apps/cms-umbraco/uSync-testinnhold/README.md): test fixtures for tt02 as uSync Content files, and how they are loaded.

## Search

- [Hybrid search](hybrid-search.md): the architecture of search, from the CMS indexing to the search dialog in the frontend.
- [The search index](elasticsearch-index.md): the index template as code, embedding in the cluster, reindexing and cold start.
- [infrastructure/elasticsearch/README.md](../infrastructure/elasticsearch/README.md): points to elasticsearch-index.md, and warns that prod and tt02 share the index.
- [Evaluation baseline](../infrastructure/elasticsearch/eval/BASELINE.md): baseline for search quality and the assessment of rerankers.

## KI-tiltak

- [Fields in ki-tiltak.json](ki-tiltak-fields.md): the fields, valid values, rules and what the tests catch.
- [The dataset behind /ki-tiltak](ki-tiltak-data.md): how the file is maintained, organisation names and new exports from the register.
- [src/data/README.md](../apps/frontend/src/data/README.md): points to the two above, and warns about the strict fields.

## Testing and local development

- [Smoke tests](smoke-tests.md): `scripts/smoke-test.sh` and the two Playwright specs that run in CI.
- [tests/README.md](../tests/README.md): points to smoke-tests.md.
- [Mock CMS](mock-cms.md): frontend without a real CMS, and how the fixture is updated.
- [tools/mock-cms/README.md](../apps/frontend/tools/mock-cms/README.md): points to mock-cms.md.
- [Route list for smoke testing](../apps/frontend/tests/fixtures/ruter.md): the fixture `routes.spec.ts` reads the routes from.
- [Favicon](../apps/frontend/public/favicon/README.md): how the PNG variants are made from the SVG.
- [PR template](../.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md): the template for PR descriptions.

## Decisions

- [Reports and decision log](reports/README.md): what the folder holds, and the rules for the text there.
- [Decision log](reports/decision-log.md): one entry per decision or milestone, newest first.

## Optional

- [Guidelines.md](../apps/frontend/guidelines/Guidelines.md): leftover from the Strapi era. Does not describe the current code.
